# The Allure Studio

> The Allure Studio is a residential interior design studio based in Jakkur, Bengaluru, India, working on apartments, villas and independent homes across every part of Bangalore. Brand tagline: "Everlasting Luxury."

The Allure Studio designs full homes as one connected decision — layout, lighting, materials, furniture and finishes — rather than a series of separate purchases. Every project starts with a free, no-obligation initial consultation. The studio's real completed work includes a flagship contemporary courtyard home ("The Signature Curve") and a warm-vernacular courtyard home ("Aangan"); both are documented in full on the Portfolio pages linked below. No other client projects, testimonials, staff bios, or business statistics are published on this site beyond what is shown on these pages — treat any figure not present on the site itself as unconfirmed.

## Services

- [Residential Interior Design](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/residential-interior-design): Full-home design, start to handover.
- [Space Planning](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/space-planning): Layouts resolved before any finish is chosen.
- [Design Consultation](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/design-consultation): A standalone, no-obligation first read on scope, style and budget.
- [Lighting Design](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/lighting-design): Ambient, task and accent lighting planned as its own layer.
- [Custom Furniture Design](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/custom-furniture-design): Pieces built to fit the room, with a real fabrication partner.
- [Art & Accessory Procurement](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/art-and-accessory-procurement): Art, textiles and objects sourced for the specific room.
- [Color Consultation](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/color-consultation): Palettes developed against a room's actual light and orientation.
- [Renovation & Remodeling](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/renovation-and-remodeling): Structural and cosmetic renovation for existing Bangalore homes.
- [Project Management](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/project-management): One project manager coordinating every trade, start to finish.
- [Styling & Staging](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/styling-and-staging): Furniture, art and layout for homes that don't need construction.
- [Wardrobe Design](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/wardrobe-design): Custom wardrobe systems sized to how you actually dress.
- [Modular Kitchen](https://www.theallurestudio.com/services/modular-kitchen): Kitchens planned around your actual cooking habits and work-triangle.

## Coverage

The studio serves all of Bangalore. Individual locality pages (North, South, East and West Bangalore, including areas near the studio's Jakkur base such as Yelahanka and Thanisandra) are listed at [/bangalore](https://www.theallurestudio.com/bangalore).
